input.summary: Extend licence to Affiliates/contractors and remove discretionary revocability
input.comment: [Playbook] A licence revocable at Vendor's sole discretion and excluding our Affiliates and contractors is not workable; we have extended the grant to Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf and limited revocation to the uncured-material-breach standard already in 13.3.

ops.oldText: Vendor grants Customer alone a non-transferable licence, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, to use the Services without Affiliates or contractors.
ops.newText: Vendor grants Customer and its Affiliates a licence, transferable as permitted by Section 13.3 and revocable only in accordance with Section 13.3, to use the Services, including through contractors acting on Customer's behalf.

input.summary: Extend Deliverable conformance warranty to 90 days and preserve remedies
input.comment: [Playbook] Fifteen days is too short and the "no correction or refund obligation" cut-off would strip the 19.4 remedy and the 19.1 warranty; we have moved to 90 days for Deliverables and preserved our other remedies.

ops.oldText: For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.
ops.newText: For ninety days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation. This period does not limit the warranties in Sections 19.1 and 19.3 or any other remedy available to Customer.

input.summary: Replace three-year take-or-pay with a 12-month reducible commitment
input.comment: [Playbook] We do not accept multi-year take-or-pay with no reduction or exit; we have limited any commitment to the current 12-month term, made it reducible on 30 days' notice with a true-up rather than a penalty, and confirmed it does not override our Section 9.4 convenience-termination right.

ops.oldText: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: Any minimum purchase commitment applies only to the current twelve-month term stated in the applicable Order Form, may be reduced by Customer on thirty days' written notice, and is settled by a true-up of Fees for Services actually ordered rather than any penalty or take-or-pay charge. No commitment limits Customer's termination rights, including under Section 9.4.

input.summary: Replace immediate-deletion clause with transition assistance obligation
input.comment: [Playbook] Clause 11.1 requires immediate cessation of assistance and deletion with no export, which contradicts 11.2–11.3 and would strand our data; we have replaced it with up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, with export and deletion governed by 11.2 and 11.3.

ops.oldText: Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
ops.newText: On expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition and migration assistance for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates. Vendor shall not delete Customer Data except in accordance with Sections 11.2 and 11.3.
